channel.title: UBC Sauder - Artificial Intelligence News
channel.description: AI news from UBC Sauder School of Business

item.title: Three human skills AI can’t replace, according to a UBC Sauder instructor
item.description: The faster AI advances, the more important it becomes to recognize what only humans can bring. Timothy Yeung, Lead Product Management Instructor at UBC Sauder Professional Growth, explores why human talent remains essential.

item.title: This UBC Sauder MBA alum is building sustainable AI infrastructure with global impact
item.description: As artificial intelligence adoption expands worldwide, Bikram Singh (UBC MBA ‘23) is focused on ensuring its infrastructure evolves sustainably

item.title: Future in Focus: Dr. Mahesh Nagarajan on Bias, Hallucinations, and Building Better AI
item.description: In his latest talk—Harnessing the AI Boom: Understanding and Utilizing Large Language Models—Dr. Mahesh Nagarajan offers a crash course on AI design and a reminder for leaders to understand its inherent biases.

item.title: How the UBC Sauder MBAN helped this alum launch a career in AI
item.description: Now a Lead Machine Learning Engineer at S&P Global, UBC MBAN alum Vibudh Singh reflects on how the program helped him transition into a career in AI.

item.title: Charting a career in AI with the UBC Sauder MBAN
item.description: UBC MBAN alum Kook Han shares how the program helped him pivot from a career in finance to artificial intelligence.

item.title: Striking the balance between automation and human expertise in business and education
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionized industries, enhancing efficiency, streamlining processes and enabling businesses to harness vast amounts of data. However, as AI continues to advance, questions about its limitations, ethical implications and role in decision-making become increasingly important.

item.title: Co-op student uses AI to bring a fresh perspective: Meet Jiawei Zhang
item.description: Frank, who is completing a Master of Business Analytic Degree at University of British Columbia’s Sauder School of Business has joined our team in Toronto for three months in a co-op placement.

item.title: Four jobs you can get with an MBA that might surprise you
item.description: Four successful alumni from the UBC Sauder School of Business discuss their innovative careers following their UBC MBA – including artificial intelligence in robotics, ESG consulting, electric vehicle infrastructure, and venture capital in healthcare. Learn more about how these talented UBC alumni secured their roles after graduation.

item.title: This UBC B+MM alum is harnessing entrepreneurship skills for a career in artificial intelligence
item.description: UBC B+MM alum, Sophie Berger, shares her experience co-founding a successful artificial intelligence technology start up and how she applied the entrepreneurial skills she learned at UBC Sauder to drive the company’s success.
